name: Arrival
headline: Make specialty appointment capacity visible
trigger: 0-70%: hold. 70-100%: the 10:30 tile becomes the next scene anchor.
behavior: The complete headline and CTAs are visible immediately. Optional 420ms flap resolves once to PENDING APPROVAL. No repeated typing.
background: Ivory base with reference-shaped ellipses and lower-left leaves. Curves move at most 32px; leaf cluster leaves with the hero.
handoff: The board time tile visually aligns to the timetable slot. Crossfade over 280ms; do not shrink the entire board into tiny unreadable text.
mobile: Headline and a compact two-line status board; no letter-by-letter flip. CTAs precede the board.
coverage: Concept stage, exact hero thesis, CTA and synthetic label.

name: Cancellation
headline: Tuesday. One cancellation.
trigger: On entry, the cancellation block lifts 12px and fades over 280ms.
behavior: The open 10:30-11:00 interval stays visible. One amber emphasis pulse, then still. Surrounding timetable slots anchor the original template.
background: Warm stone shape rises behind the open interval; retain the same background object.
handoff: The interval stretches horizontally into seven labelled constraint lanes.
mobile: Show three neighboring times and the open interval; all other slots can collapse to a summary.

name: Constraints
headline: See what has to line up.
trigger: Pinned travel 0-33%: reveal seven lanes; hold labels before proceeding.
behavior: Clinician, room, duration, equipment, payer/authorization, interpreter and transport are visible. Eligibility is an administrative source field, never a clinical verdict.
background: Same ivory plane; background movement pauses during dense evidence.
handoff: Room and interpreter lanes extend toward candidate rows; keep the open slot fixed.
mobile: Stack all seven lanes as a normal document. No pinned map, clipped labels or horizontal-only controls.
coverage: D-01 / R-02 / EQ-01 / 30 min; version and source timestamps.

name: Candidates
headline: Three candidates. Show the reason.
trigger: Pinned travel 33-66%: reveal A, B, C in order with 100ms offsets.
behavior: A: room/equipment unavailable. B: interpreter not available at 10:30. C: pending scheduler review. Dim decorative card surfaces, not the text.
background: Background is held still; amber follows the selected open interval, not a patient ranking.
handoff: C opens into a review packet; excluded candidates remain summarized alongside.
mobile: Three stacked cards with reason text and an evidence disclosure. No carousel required.
coverage: No ranking by clinical worth; all candidates remain synthetic.

name: Review
headline: The scheduler still decides.
trigger: Pinned travel 66-100%: hold pending state; unpin into normal scroll.
behavior: Click Simulate approval only after evidence review. Local result: FILLED - SIMULATED, with No appointment booked. Actual case state is Reviewed handoff; draft remains UNSENT.
background: Ivory surface, quiet backdrop, stable controls. Scroll never triggers a decision.
handoff: The audit event becomes the connector to the exception section; scrolling onward is always possible without clicking.
mobile: Evidence appears before the action. Button and Reset are keyboard reachable; keep form focus stable.
coverage: Owner, source, CV-03, timestamp, permission state and local-only action.

name: Exceptions
headline: Missing evidence is a reason to pause.
trigger: Click case tabs; scroll only reveals the resting default.
behavior: Clean, ambiguous and blocked cases. Unknown interpreter/authorization evidence stays unresolved. Missing equipment and override rights cause abstention, not a guessed match.
background: A dark ink inset opens with a curved ivory boundary; the outer page stays warm.
handoff: The evidence connector becomes five editorial module rules as the dark inset ends.
mobile: Three full-width case buttons and inline details; all states remain accessible without motion.
coverage: Three-case specification; no PHI, automatic decisions or fabricated confidence.

name: Modules
headline: Five proposed modules. One workflow.
trigger: Each row enters when its top reaches 80% of viewport. 160ms fade, no staggered waiting.
behavior: Five distinct editorial rows in source order. Review is marked First pilot direction. Mini-scenes explain visibility, queue, routing, simulation and segmented analysis.
background: Ivory returns through a curved boundary; no new unrelated gradient.
handoff: The Review row becomes a small handoff packet carried into audience roles.
mobile: Five ordinary stacked rows with full descriptors and links.
coverage: All five offers retained exactly; proposed, not live plans.

name: People
headline: Start where scheduling work happens.
trigger: Scroll reveals roles; selecting a role changes its descriptive panel.
behavior: Specialty practices, access departments and practice-management consultants. COO/access director buys; scheduler manager operates; oversight owner reviews guardrails.
background: Warm stone at the perimeter; center remains near white.
handoff: The packet settles beside existing EHR and staff workflow rails.
mobile: Stack role stories; avoid drag-only access.
coverage: Specific validation buyers; no invented customer logos or endorsements.

name: Alternatives
headline: Start with the workflow you have.
trigger: Two process rails draw once on entry; labels stay visible.
behavior: Native EHR scheduling, staff/call centers, spreadsheets and self-service may already suffice. Kyruus is adjacent self-service; Qventus is adjacent surgical capacity.
background: Slightly deeper stone field signals comparison; no claims of measured efficiency.
handoff: Both rails meet an evaluation scorecard rather than a celebratory outcome.
mobile: Vertical before/after illustration with the same comparison caveats.
coverage: Illustrative manual-check vs review-packet workflow; no invented time saved.

name: Evidence
headline: A useful question before a promise.
trigger: Source links open on explicit action. Metric labels do not count upward.
behavior: Measure feasible slots filled within original template windows against a matched baseline; record denominator and uncertainty. Guardrails: review minutes and constraint violations.
background: Cream reading surface, still background. Only source connectors animate.
handoff: A source timestamp widens into the five-day replay line.
mobile: Source list and scorecard as text/table. No hover-only citations.
coverage: Low incremental-ROI evidence; access/write-back, freshness, rules, payer, fairness and ownership gaps.

name: Replay
headline: Start with one week of cancellations.
trigger: Scroll activates five day markers sequentially; clicking a day opens its scope.
behavior: After authorized scope/data readiness: intake, map rules, replay, compare with schedulers, review decision. Nothing is uploaded through this page.
background: The original timetable line returns, now a week. Warm amber accents five milestones.
handoff: Final review marker aligns with the commercial hypothesis and readiness gate.
mobile: Five stacked milestones; show prerequisites before the day list.
coverage: Two groups; authorized retrospective exports; named owner and measured endpoint.

name: Pricing
headline: Test the workflow. Then test the price.
trigger: Single short entrance; no animated prices or tier carousel.
behavior: Hypothetical test price: $900 per specialty site/month + $2,000 setup. Test site vs provider budgeting. No checkout and no established separate replay price.
background: Quiet warm ivory; no kinetic or floating price card.
handoff: Price rule continues into FAQ; keep links to scope and evaluation nearby.
mobile: One price block and full disclosures, with no tiny footnotes.
coverage: Pilot: 8 interviews, 2 replay commitments, 1 paid letter + security/data/oversight approvals.

name: Questions
headline: Clear answers before a commitment.
trigger: Accordion opens only on click/keyboard, 160ms maximum; state persists during scroll.
behavior: Answer availability, booking, messages, EHR access, current waitlist, data, unknowns, price, fairness, results, pilot prerequisites and clinical guidance.
background: Near-white cream, virtually static. The connector waits at the open question.
handoff: The final question resolves into the replay invitation; no forced completion of FAQs.
mobile: Native disclosure controls; show open content inline.
coverage: All 12 FAQ commitments from the IA; complete answers in accessible DOM.

name: Invitation
headline: Could a replay clarify your workflow?
trigger: The original 30-minute interval returns as an open question, not a booked slot.
behavior: Ask business role, organization, work email, specialty, site count/region, scheduling system and one workflow-fit question. No patient data or files.
background: Hero curves return subtly; warm ivory colors remain. Amber highlights the inquiry action.
handoff: The timeline ends at the W symbol above the complete footer.
mobile: One-column labelled form. Preserve entries and errors; never auto-scroll away from focus.
coverage: Consent notice/version, deletion route; source/UTM only after approved tracking. No live collection in this assignment.

name: Footer
headline: A calm end, with clear next steps.
trigger: No entrance animation required. A fine line ends at the W mark.
behavior: Direct links to products, demo, method, governance, data, pricing, company, contact, legal and access status. Only verified social URLs.
background: Warm ivory, fully settled. No looping animation or moving link targets.
handoff: Navigation works directly; returning to the top restores the story without undoing a local review decision.
mobile: Grouped links expand accessibly; no long pinned footer.
coverage: Concept disclosure, no operating product, honest workspace-access page.
